notes.title: Beaver Fun™ River Run - Steam Edition (Update v1.1.0)
notes.content:
Hi to everyone!

Beaver Fun™ River Run - Steam Edition has been updated to version 1.1.0.


 Implemented Steam Achievements


The prior release (v1.0.1) can be played by selecting it from the Beaver Fun™ River Run - Steam Edition beta tab.

notes.title: Beaver Fun™ River Run - Steam Edition (Update v1.0.1)
notes.content:
Hi to everyone!

Beaver Fun™ River Run - Steam Edition has been updated to version 1.0.1.


 Added ability to launch the game from the splash screen using the controller.
 Added egg splat animation to beaver's head for the duration of egg splat events.
 Added ability to exit the game (by pressing ESC key) when game is in paused state. 
 Increased overall speed of river.
 Decreased the race timer's default starting time to compensate for increased river speed.


The prior release (v1.0.0) can be played by selecting it from the Beaver Fun™ River Run - Steam Edition beta tab.
